image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a bison standing in a grassy field. The image captures the head, prominent shoulder hump, and forequarters in detail. The fur is thick, shaggy, and dark brown. One horn is clearly visible, curved and light-colored at the tip. The background shows blurred vegetation and a hint of another bison's back in the upper left.
